analysis.title: PTS Technical Views: Equity Indices
key_insights: S&P 500 bullish extension scenario invalidated: the breakout above the wave-5 target was a false breakout and the picture now fits a higher-degree wave-4 correction. The index is testing support at 6,817.
Oversold momentum, VIX near 36 and Tech nearing key support may be consistent with a tactical rebound, but breadth has not reached capitulation and a major bottom is unconfirmed.
S&P 500 MT: wave (3) likely completed near 7,744. A break below 6,817 opens 6,182, while a recovery above the 200-day SMA and 7,493 is needed to stabilise.
S&P 500 LT: failed to hold the breakout above 7,459-7,500, invalidating the 8,715-9,000 extension. Price action reads as a correction within the secular rising channel in place since the GFC.

Breadth: only 46.0% of members above the 200-day SMA and 42.6% above the 50-day SMA. Only 5.57% make new 52-week lows and 10.16% have 14-day RSI below 30, well below 2022 and April 2025 capitulation extremes.
Tactical path: decline from the 7,845 bull-trap high may be a five-wave impulse. A wave-4 rebound could retest 7,267-7,350, with a wave 5 lower still possible.
S&P 500 Equal Weight broke below its 200-day SMA and tests 8,368 support. A break targets 7,933, and the 200-day SMA near 8,472 may act as resistance.
Equal Weight/SPX ratio broke above 1.198 resistance from a 1.09-1.11 double bottom, RSI above 70. It supports continued Equal Weight outperformance if 1.198 holds, though it may consolidate.
VIX at 35.9 after breaking above 20, with RSI 71.7 overbought. Resistance is at 36.97 and the next upside level is 42.43, and a pullback could support an equity relief rally.
Nasdaq 100 correction is more advanced than the S&P 500, with 24,000-23,370 the next stabilisation zone. The secular uptrend is intact above 22,223 structural support, and 27,900 is pivotal.

Nasdaq 100/S&P 500 ratio broke below its channel and the 3.77-3.82 zone, holding above 3.59-3.66. A tactical rebound is possible, but until 3.77-3.82 is recovered the relative trend favours the S&P 500.
Russell 2000 is below its 200-day SMA, testing 2,559, with major support at 2,450-2,401 and RSI not yet oversold.
Europe is less advanced in its correction than the US. EURO STOXX 50 tests rising trend and 200-day SMA support, with 5,792 below, and DAX tests 25,040-24,980 with 24,432 below.
CAC 40 is fragile after repeated failures above 8,200, with 7,759-7,524 in focus. SMI is retesting the 14,669-14,594 breakout, with 15,151 the upside target.
S&P 500/STOXX Europe 600 ratio holds above 12.95 and 12.48 support. A break below 12.48 would signal structural rotation to Europe, and a recovery above 14.53 revives US leadership towards 15.22.
Asia: Hang Seng broke trend support and 22,742-22,990, with 21,425 next. Nikkei tests 56,899-56,437 with potential bullish RSI divergence and a break below 56,437 targets 51,914.

sector_views.rationale: Correction more advanced than the S&P, with 24,000-23,370 support near. Relative trend still favours the S&P 500 until the ratio recovers 3.77-3.82.
Russell 2000 is below its 200-day SMA with 2,450-2,401 as the major support zone.

risk_factors: S&P 500 break below 6,817 would bring 6,182 into focus.
Absence of breadth capitulation means a wave 5 lower remains possible.
Nasdaq 100 failure at 24,000-23,370 would extend the correction towards 22,223.
EURO STOXX 50 break of rising trendline would target 5,792, and a STOXX 600 break below its 200-day SMA near 630 would question the 746 target.
Hang Seng secular downtrend and Nikkei break below 56,437 targeting 51,914.
